verified_scope: offline source and disposable CI tests only; not an operational attestation

gates.requirement: Real GitHub issuer JWKS, immutable workflow claims, trusted clock, HTTPS identity binding
gates.required_evidence: Independent service-side integration logs with redacted claims, negative replay/forgery tests and reviewed exact deployment commit

gates.requirement: End-to-end body hash/nonce/JTI and account+bot binding independent of caller assertions
gates.required_evidence: Durable database and service crash/replay tests across restarts, with reviewer-confirmed identity-to-request correlation

gates.requirement: Dedicated least-privilege production roles and hardened SECURITY DEFINER functions
gates.required_evidence: Real-role SQL ACL snapshots, no superuser and no direct table write tests on the actual target database

gates.requirement: Verified host process permissions, secret isolation, and egress restrictions
gates.required_evidence: Actual effective systemd/container state, namespace and firewall measurements from target host

gates.requirement: Authenticated read-only TLS transport to explicitly allowed exchange /info endpoints
gates.required_evidence: Observed testnet TLS and network deny tests with independent packet/egress evidence and zero signing keys

gates.requirement: Durable and independently verified account-wide history beyond provider retention limits
gates.required_evidence: Baseline checkpoint, archival completeness audit and documented treatment of older/manual positions

gates.requirement: Trusted account-wide fills/orders/positions reconcile correctly under concurrent bot/manual activity
gates.required_evidence: Integration traces of mixed-owner/partial-fill/legacy attribution and manual-dispute escalation

gates.requirement: All original bot execution paths lack credentials and order egress; sole signer fenced
gates.required_evidence: Proof all five execution invocations migrated, secret access revoked, network egress blocked, and account-wide mutex tests

gates.requirement: Explicit-size exchange-enforced reduce-only closes with ownership and position precision
gates.required_evidence: Independent testnet evidence for partial, unknown-ACK, stale position, emergency exit, TP/SL and outage scenarios

gates.requirement: Persistent no-blind-retry unknown ACK and restart-safe reconciliation
gates.required_evidence: Live-protocol testnet reconciliation and delayed/missing ACK/reconnect drills with reviewer signoff

gates.requirement: Outage alerts, kill switches, reconciliation monitoring, rescue procedure, and tested rollback
gates.required_evidence: Human-observed response drill with logs, documented responsibilities, rollback playbook and open-position protection

gates.requirement: Independent expert review of exact code, dependencies, permissions, host and risk controls
gates.required_evidence: Signed review record with exact Git commit and deployed artifact digests

gates.requirement: Separate explicit approval for a specific testnet account and bounded experiments
gates.required_evidence: Operator approval referencing account, region/network, risk cap, scope, commit and permitted date

gates.requirement: Distinct explicit live authorization following testnet evidence and new security review
gates.required_evidence: Separate production approval tied to live account, maximum risk, version, monitoring and revocation plan
